Troubleshooting

Nothing happens

Would you be able to start a bit smaller?

Show yourself one sensation in your body, one word, whether to listen or rest today etc?

It feels fake

Do you know what is fake about it? The words/image/what you are expecting/ the role? It might be that you just don’t have that ‘thing’ in your head (voice/image etc) yet. It isn’t because you don’t have a ‘thing’ in your head doing this that you don’t have this ‘grown up’ thing yet or that you are resisting doing this. If it feels like you are being asked to do something you don’t want to do, then correct this. It could be that you have a part that is trying to protect you from doing this, so talk to this part.

Maybe try asking it “what are you protecting me from?” Or “are you afraid that I am going to lie to myself again?” Or “are you afraid that this is going to be a performance?”

It could be that you have picked up an inner voice of a parent that is enforcing a rule that if you do this then you will belong. In this case, don’t argue with this part. Try and find out what rule it is enforcing and then try and find some ‘every day life’ evidence to support your new ‘grown up’ voice.

If it feels like you are picking up that you don’t have this ‘thing’ in your head yet, that tells you that you shouldn’t try and believe what this ‘thing’ (inner voice) is saying yet. As long as you have some ‘observing ego’ to do this work, you can borrow what you need from someone that you know has got this ‘thing’ (warmth, boundaries, direction etc). It could be a family member, friend, famous person etc. Try something out that rings true for you, it could be a sentence, action etc and see how it goes.

The subconscious will not answer

There may not be an answer. There may not be an answer that will help you. You may need to try asking a different question or you may just need to rest or finish your inner work for the day. If trust is actually a concern, you can try asking your subconscious “What would you need to know in order to trust me?” Some examples of answers might be “I need to know you will set boundaries” “I need to know you will do what you said you will do” “I need to know you won’t keep leaving” “I need to know you won’t think that knowing something means that you don’t need to do anything about it” etc.

The inner child will not appear

If you can figure out who the guard is, talk to it. If you can’t, just work with what you are aware of. You can say to the guard “You don’t have to let me in, just tell me what I need to do to make it safe”. Even if there isn’t a child part that you can talk to, you can work with whatever you are aware of. You can work on your preferences or something that you’re curious about or something that you’re willing to try as a beginner etc. and see how it goes. Work on developing a sense of who you are and reparent yourself as best you can.

You get anxious

Find out if the anxiety is bad enough that you want to decrease contact with it or if you can manage it and let it continue. If the anxiety is getting too bad, then you need to stop searching for content and help your body first, like the following:

-Where are your feet? Where are you sitting? Focus on your body, your breathing, and the room around you.

-Tell your Little parts and Protector parts that you’re there for your Little parts and that you recognize that your Protector parts are trying to protect you and that you don’t need them to scream at you in order for you to know that something is wrong. Ask them if they need you to do something and if they do, ask them to show you one step at a time that you can do. If they don’t, then ask them to let your body calm down.

If you’re having chest pain, fainting, suicidal thoughts, psychosis-like symptoms, mania-like symptoms, severe dissociative symptoms, not being able to sleep, wanting to hurt yourself or somebody else, etc. then you need to get professional help. For more on handling anxiety, see the toolbox in Appendix D.

You dissociate or feel unreal

Open your eyes, move around, feel something textured, name 5 things that you can see, and end your work for the day.

You become grandiose

Go eat, go to sleep, do some chores, accept some humility, find somebody to disagree with you, etc.

What do you say to yourself in that moment? “If it’s really there, it’ll still be here after a good night’s sleep, some food, some time, etc, and some subsequent humility, feedback, etc, etc.”

You become too analytical

You’re being too analytical. “What if you didn’t try to improve it?” Put your hand on your heart, your other on your solar plexis, and say, “I don’t have to do this perfectly. I’m here for a relationship with something deeper than my surface mind.” “What can you do to make this a communion, not a performance?” Maybe it’s silence, resting, or doing something. Whatever it is, just do it.

You become too blissful or diffuse

You’re being too blissful, diffuse, etc. Bring it down to a more specific level. “What’s the smallest, most specific thing you can do to demonstrate the love you’re feeling?”

You want the hidden truth immediately

Don’t pry.

“Show me the capacity before the content.”

You keep daydreaming

You’re daydreaming. Sit up and open your eyes, and ask yourself, “What are you avoiding doing in the real world by doing this?”

You get stuck in spiritual bypass

“Where has divine love not yet descended into the wound?”

Maybe you had a profound opening that showed you how much more love and freedom is possible. Let that matter, but don’t demand that the child receive it on command. Maybe when you prayed it seemed like you were being abandoned and condemned. Maybe you felt betrayed by a spiritual teacher. It may be worth exploring these, but you might not want to do more of the same.

Sometimes it’s best to get some practical help while life still feels too small, and let yourself be curious about finding more happiness, without necessarily believing the explanation of how it’s going to work. Sometimes people have enough love and meaning to just live their lives, and trying to be spiritual doesn’t have to be another assignment.

You get stuck in endless processing

You may have a real wound that needs to be dealt with, but it’s possible you’re caught in a checking loop. Consider asking yourself “Will processing this again actually help me feel, understand, decide, or do something differently? Or is this a form of checking to see if I can get the reassurance that something is finally okay?” Sometimes, whether you’re grieving or doing your practice, it’s okay to cover the same ground again and again.

The best thing to do, though, if you notice you’re in a checking loop, is allow the thought to be there without engaging with it and get on with what you have chosen to do. You don’t have to have a meeting with every thought that pops into your head before you start your life. You don’t have to do any certain thing before you start your life.

What would the Leader choose to do now?

You keep using hypnosis but not changing life

You’re doing hypnosis over and over again without making changes in your life. Ask yourself, “What can I do to show my kid I’m for real?” Then go do it.

HG36-ea:
Appendix G: Altered states

NB: I am NOT saying use substances. However, many people attempt to do things for the first time such as self hypnosis, contact with their inner child, contact with their Higher Self etc when they are in a mind altered state.

If you do use them, be aware you don't want to force a revelation out of the state but instead use it to help you do things in your regular life.

If you have had an opening in the past, the key is to recognize that it is different to have an experience, access it in a particular state and access it in your day to day life. It is great that it has opened but if the child can't take it in, then meet the difficulty rather than escalating the intensity.

Use phrases such as; Help me to ground. Help me to only take that which I can take in. Help me to remember love. Help me to come back when the time is right. Help me to take one change into my regular life.

You should NOT use self hypnosis to; Keep you in that state forever Get memories to come up Make yourself afraid to do things Not sleep Override things that your body needs Not talk to people

If you are doing this in an altered state of consciousness and it is helping you not to love, not to ground, not to be honest, not to sleep, not to communicate, not to do regular life things, you need to STOP trying to go deeper and work on integrating what you have.

Stabilize before you interpret

Self hypnosis is powerful. Especially when you are in an altered state of consciousness, either through loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grief, sexual energy, prayer, not sleeping, or any other number of ways similar to plant medicines, often your mind opens faster then your adult can figure out what is going on.

It can be useful to notice that a certain state of intensity may have meaning: perhaps it is a way of connecting with inner child parts, or a Protector who is afraid, or other parts who feel shame/grief/anger/longing etc. It can also be that the body is overloaded, the environment is chaotic, there’s a sleep deficit or there’s confusion about something. Already open? Contain before you deepen

This is useful when you've already opened a state, through means other than doing a deliberate process - like taking loveyhuasca, doing a different style of meditation, being in a lucid dream, dealing with grief, listening to music, praying, engaging with erotic energy, exhaustion or even being overwhelmed by the beauty of something. When you've done that, then you want to stabilize the state before making it stronger.

Say to yourself 'The state is already open, I do not need to intensify it, I just need to aim it, stabilize it and be kind to myself as I do.'

Look around you in the room, notice where you are and what date (or at least what day) it is. Feel your feet, hands and spine to ground yourself. Focus on the physical sensation of pressing your thumbs against your index fingers, feel the friction.

Say to yourself 'I will only allow myself to go as far as I can integrate. If there is more, it can wait. My body will be safe, my adult self will be present so my inner child does not have to carry this alone.

Once you are oriented, then pick one of the following: 'Please show me the next thing I need to know, in a form (symbol, feeling, question, action) that I can integrate.'

Stay awake when your mind likes to escape

Staying awake when your mind wants to escape You can do this sitting up, with your eyes open, feeling your feet, and allowing your breathing to be natural.

Start by saying 'Today I am not going to escape from here into my mind, instead I will be more present here.'

Pick an object to look at, feel your spine as you do.

Now ask yourself 'Am I daydreaming in a way that is receiving guidance or helping me integrate emotional experiences, or am I escaping?'

Then say 'Please help me, if I am receiving guidance, to see what action I need to take, if I am escaping, please help me be present and show me what I am escaping.'

If whenever you stop, you escape into sleepiness and diffuse states, work on increasing your alertness instead of relaxing, keep your eyes open, work on doing something with your hands, doing it for a while, and then deliberately stopping it and noticing what comes afterwards without escaping into your mind.

For example say to yourself 'While you keep your eyes open, press your thumb and forefinger together and let go again a few times. Each time do it more clearly and in a more alert state. Now deliberately stop doing it and notice what happens in the first second after you do, do you feel an echo, or can you feel nothing?' Stay upright while you work at this level.

The two-hand induction

Where are YOUR hands? Put one of YOUR hands on YOUR heart. Put the other of YOUR hands on YOUR solar plexis.

The hand on YOUR heart is the Nurturer. The hand on YOUR solar plexis is the vulnerable child in YOU.

Breathe gently and affirm

The love is above and the child is below. And the adult is present.

I send love down to the child. And I receive signal from the child. Then I send more love down. And I listen to the signal again.

Sleep induction

This induction is different from the others, because in the others you need to get all the way back to your Adult to be able to write, do things, etc. In this case, the point is to go to sleep, so it is good for analysis to NOT be on duty and for revelation to wait.

To hear a hypnosis that will put you to sleep, check out Nimja's playlist here .

Optional fractionation: practice coming back

Say that this is fractionation before you do it. Ok, now I'd like you to open your eyes and come back. Do you want to stop the hypnosis? If not, close or soften your eyes and notice what's different as you go back into absorption. You can stop either way.

Deepening, if useful

If deepening isn't useful, stay exactly as awake as you need to be. Take yourself to your room in your heart, your garden or temple of inner peace, sit next to a fire with your Protector, float on a lake, sit in a chair where an adult waits for you, etc, etc, etc. Just pick one.

And see who wants to talk to you first.

Trance (optional):

Optional trance depth check

Give yourself permission to not have to do anything.

"If it is useful, my wise subconscious may cause one of my fingers to twitch, or pulse, or lift up, or get warm, or tingly, or whatever, to let me know that I am ready to meet with whomever wants to see me in my inner space." And of course you're not going to make it happen, or pretend it is happening, you're just going to wait in love.

It doesn't mean that anything will happen, but if something happens with one of your fingers, or you feel some other bodily change, none of it proves truth; at most, something may be listening.

A shortcut back into hypnosis

Once you've learned a useful induction and also the full return below, you can make up your own shortcut for getting back under hypnosis. My dad used to do a mudra (hand sign) by bringing two fingers together in an "okay" sign, and it would help him relax. He even did it while driving, but that's his experience, not a recommendation to enter trance at the wheel. So keep the cue you use for calming yourself while alert separate from the one for going into inward hypnosis!

Choose a Unique Word, Phrase or Movement You may want to add a gesture, but it's not necessary. When you are in a familiar and welcome hypnotic state that you like - not at the height of an emotional experience, and not in a child state or with a traumatic scene - start to pair that state with that word, phrase or gesture. You are giving that word, phrase or gesture a meaning that you choose.

When you are in a place and time where you have set aside time and it is appropriate and you want to deliberately start hypnosis with your short cut, then you can return to this familiar way of listening, from where you can change the direction of your experience or end the hypnosis.

Return fully. When at another appropriate time you want to deliberately start practicing hypnosis, use your short cut. Give it time. You can start to make your longer induction shorter as you find that the short cut works, but if it doesn't work, you can always use the familiar induction. There is no set number of times that you need to do this, or that you need to be instantaneously really deep into hypnosis or experience a particular sensation, it is completely up to you.

First, is it useful? Will it be there when you want it to be, not there when you don't want it to be? Can you change direction and return when you want to? It shouldn't become obedience to a narrator, notification, or overheard word. Going in faster doesn't determine what material you can handle.

Never train, test, or use hypnotic re-entry while driving or anything where you need to be actively paying attention even if it is open eyed and even if the words are conditional.

And if you don't want to any more, just stop doing it, remove it from any recordings you are using, any active apps, use an induction you are familiar with and state that you are finished using it whilst awake. If this doesn't stop the association straight away, and you are still getting unwanted affects or feeling disorientated, seek qualified help to sort it out. Until the next time you want to do it, you should not use the trigger.

Come all the way back

Bring yourself out of the session, in reverse order of how you got into it. If you floated up, float back down again, etc., remembering that you have whatever weight you chose earlier in the session. If you shrank yourself, grow back to your normal size. If you went back to when you were younger or went inside to talk to parts of yourself, remember that you are now a whole person, this is your body, and you're using your adult judgement now. If you traveled somewhere, come back in the same way that you went, remembering to bring back only that which you chose to bring back.

Say to yourself, "I am bringing back only that which will be of use to me now. Everything else will remain safely stored until such time as I choose to use it. I am now coming back to this place, to my body, to normal living, to one honest action at a time. From this point on, nothing will make me go inside again unless I choose to use these practices again in the future."

Count yourself out of the session: "One, coming back into your body, remembering that you have whatever weight you chose at the beginning of the session. Two, coming back to normal breathing. Three, becoming aware of all the sounds around you now, and where you are. Four, moving your fingers, your toes, your shoulders, your eyes. Five, opening your eyes, feeling normal, the session is now over."

Whether coming out of an induction by a live person or from an audio recording, once you are told or instructed to open your eyes, you may want to enhance your coming out by saying to yourself either what day it is or what date it is, looking to your left and right, looking at something close and something far away, moving a bit before standing up. Once you feel steady, stand up. Make sure you are oriented and alert. Just because you can count does not mean you are oriented and alert. Mentally make note of any information that came up during the session and if there is something that you need or do not need to do as a result of the session. Then proceed to do whatever it is that you normally do.

In the event that you are using a recording and for some reason it stops, just say to yourself that the recording has stopped and the session is over. Then use the above method to come out by opening your eyes, saying where you are, saying what day it is, pushing down with your feet or hands, moving about, looking about and then using the 5 step method listed above.

NOTE: When using a recording to take you into a sleep state, it is fine to let the recording put you to sleep or into a quiet time of resting. But when using a recording during a waking practice, the recording should not be leaving you in a role, with lowered judgement, with lowered movement capabilities, blank, with an un-defined “reset word” or inviting you to stay in an altered state for an unlimited amount of time.
